verdict.rationale: WorkOS is API-first and publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json. It ships an official Node SDK with automatic retry/backoff, and its docs describe API-driven role assignment, an Events API, and data import via the AuthKit API. Its MCP server lets agents change dashboard data by calling the WorkOS API, and llms.txt and markdown docs make the documentation agent-friendly. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving workspace management through the API (community praise covers the SSO/SCIM wrapper generally), and evidence of API-reference detail such as rate limits.
